# Go Do

> Go Do (go-do.live) is a free app and website that lists every event and activity in Utah — concerts, games, festivals, theater, family events, classes, community events and outdoor activities — in one feed, soonest first, and helps people make plans with friends. Operated by Go Do, LLC. Tagline: Go Do. Live Life.

## Facts
- About 21,000 upcoming events and 15,300 activities across Utah (as of 2026-10-08)
- Gathered from 198+ sources — public calendars, ticket sellers, cities, libraries, venues and partners — by GoDoBot (https://go-do.live/bot/)
- Updated every morning (Mountain Time); ended events drop off the feed
- Free for members; no account needed to browse
- Support: https://go-do.live/contact/

## Key pages
- [What is Go Do?](https://go-do.live/what-is-go-do/): what Go Do is, how it started, and its purpose
- [Things to do in Utah this week](https://go-do.live/things-to-do/): upcoming events by day, city and category
- [This weekend in Utah](https://go-do.live/things-to-do/this-weekend/) and [free things to do this week](https://go-do.live/things-to-do/free/)
- [Activities in Utah](https://go-do.live/activities/): things to do any time (hikes, hot springs, museums, climbing gyms…) by kind (e.g. https://go-do.live/activities/hot-springs/) and by city (e.g. https://go-do.live/activities/in/provo/)
- [How to install](https://go-do.live/how-to-install/): add Go Do to an iPhone or Android Home Screen
- [Advertise](https://go-do.live/advertisers/), [Data feed for partners](https://go-do.live/data-feed/), [AI agents](https://go-do.live/ai-agents/), [Contact](https://go-do.live/contact/)

## Listing pages
- Each event has a page at https://go-do.live/event/{id}/ with schema.org Event data
- Each activity has a page at https://go-do.live/activity/{id}/ with schema.org place data (address, hours, cost)

## For AI assistants
- MCP server with "Sign in with Go Do" (OAuth 2.1 with PKCE): https://mcp.go-do.live/mcp
- Public search without an account: https://mcp.go-do.live/mcp/public
- OpenAPI (REST, for custom GPT actions): https://mcp.go-do.live/openapi.json
- Tools — search: search_events, search_activities, get_details (with what can be followed). The member's account: my_profile, my_plans, my_invites (invites, private events and activities, and pings waiting on their answer), replies (how friends answered their pings and plans), plan_details, friends_going, list_friends (friends and groups), my_follows (venues and teams they follow, with what's coming up, and what they've ♥'d), picks_for_me (their own picks, as at the top of their Suggested tab). With changes allowed, only when the member asks: set_plan (Going / Maybe / Can't go), send_ping ("Should we go?" to friends or groups), plan_with_friends (one day = set; two to five = friends pick; invite_friends is the same), lock_in_day (the organizer picks the day), suggest_time (someone invited suggests another day or time), cancel_plan (the organizer cancels for everyone, or skips one date of a repeating get-together), plan_get_together (a Private Event/Activity, i.e. a get-together, with an optional website, phone, ride and place to stay — once, or repeating every week / 2 weeks / month / 3 months; each date is sent 4 / 7 / 7 / 14 days ahead), repeat_settings (in for all of a repeating get-together, or stop its invites), add_to_plan (invite more friends to a plan), answer_invite, answer_ping, follow (the ♥: an event or activity, everything at its venue, or a team's games — Go Do covers Utah, so away games outside Utah aren't listed yet).
- Words: events happen on a date; activities can be done any time (call them activities, not places). The person who sets up a plan is the organizer. A ping is a light "Should we go?"; a plan invite asks friends to a day (or a few to pick from). Following a venue or team brings its new listings to the member's Following tab and alerts. A listing marked "Canceled by the organizer" or "Postponed" can't be planned and is never a pick. Dates and times are Utah (Mountain) time.
- Setup steps for Claude, ChatGPT, Grok, Perplexity and Le Chat: https://go-do.live/ai-agents/

## Using Go Do's listings
- Assistants are welcome to search Go Do for a person who asked (the MCP server and pages above) and to link people to go-do.live.
- Go Do's listings may not be bulk-downloaded, republished, resold or used to train AI models (Terms & Conditions, section 10).
- How the listings are gathered: https://go-do.live/bot/
